_comment: Dialogue lines for Ono, the small companion NPC in the hub world. Each pool is an array of 'sequences' (an array of lines shown one at a time); Companion.gd picks one sequence at random depending on how far along the student's overall mastery is. Written warm and understated - never twee, never scored harshly.

early: Oh - hello. I didn't hear you come in.
This is a quiet sort of place. Take whatever time you need with it.
Somewhere out there, on a screen just like the one you're looking at now, this is a real exam. I know. Let's go gently.
Ten ideas, six more, and a few in te reo Māori. That's a lot to carry.
You don't have to carry all of it today. Just pick a door.
mid: A few of these rooms have a bit more colour in them now. That was you.
Keep going - not fast, just steady.
Error Prevention and Error Recovery still mix people up, you know.
Before the mistake, or after it. That's the whole difference. You'll get it.
late: It's brighter than when you found it. That wasn't luck - that was you sitting with the hard bits.
Whatever room this understanding lives in on the actual exam day, I hope some of this stays with you.
You could stop here, if you wanted. It would still count.
Or you could go round again. Some things are worth knowing properly, not just well enough.

locked_door: Finish the room before it, and this one will open on its own.
